name: branding-logo-printed-tape-in-violet-black-and-grey-on-concrete
title: Violet, grey and black packing tape printed with a repeating logo on grey concrete
whatItIs: An angled photo of three strips of adhesive tape on rough concrete: a grey one, a bright violet one folding upward into shadow, and a black one, each printed with a repeating symbol and wordmark.
whatItMeans: Confident and industrial; the repeat pattern turns a logo into ownable texture.
techniques: Print the logo as a repeating pattern on tape.
Fold the tape to catch light and shadow.
Show three colourways on a raw surface.

vocabulary.definition: A logo tiled as a pattern.
Adhesive tape used as a brand surface.
